title: Linked notes and heading navigation
extraChecks: Follow docs/testing/editor.md for pointer, selection, or cursor changes; navigation planning alone is covered below the browser layer.

title: Editor geometry, widgets, and Vim
extraChecks: Run the affected existing editorUX or vimVisualRows Playwright scenario for geometry changes and repeat in the packaged native webview.

title: Editor shell, window title, and pane launchers
extraChecks: Reuse existing outline and windowChrome browser boundaries for focus, accessibility, or geometry changes; verify native window behavior in the packaged webview.

title: Editor update dependencies and interaction diagnostics
extraChecks: Run tabs/editor-layout and affected observer suites. Reuse editorUX/outline/vimVisualRows browser tests and isolated packaged native input checks.

title: Rich paste, copy, and clipboard images
extraChecks: Actual clipboard events need the existing browser/native clipboard boundary; pure conversion and failure cases stay in focused tests.

title: Writing analysis and scheduling
extraChecks: Use writing-grammar, writing-spelling, writing-retention, writing-inline, or writing-decisions for those changes. Worker/startup changes also need the existing productionBundle boundary.

title: Writing advice context, punctuation and equivalence
extraChecks: Run the production whole-document evaluator on frozen regression and fresh manifests; record every finding and offered edit separately from expectations. Runtime changes also require existing eager-startup and packaged native boundaries.
Run node scripts/profile-writing.mjs to combine production native and JavaScript editorial findings.

title: Curated English grammar and safe corrections
extraChecks: Run go test ./internal/writing/... and (cd third_party/vale && go test -race ./...). Native grammar_test.go verifies the bridge fixture and pinned assets; grammar/grammar_test.go and grammar/corpus_test.go own pure rules and the shared reviewed minimal pairs.

Regenerate fixtures only with node scripts/update-writing-grammar-fixtures.mjs and review the diff. Engine changes require actual native startup, full review, Apply/Undo, typing/save, cancellation/reuse, and shutdown; run the existing productionBundle browser boundary.

title: Whole-document editorial evaluation
extraChecks: Run node scripts/evaluate-writing-documents.mjs --output /tmp/figaro-writing-documents.json to inspect actual combined-provider results. Preserve source/license hashes; manual labels are separate from output and do not establish held-out accuracy.

title: Spelling and protected source ranges
extraChecks: Personal-word resolution and shared technical masking also need writing. Persistence changes need go test ./internal/settings ./internal/desktop -run SpellingDictionary. Package mapping changes need the existing productionBundle boundary.

title: Retain review results while typing
extraChecks: Underlines, cursor geometry, and popup focus changes require the existing editorUX and packaged-native boundary.

title: Inline writing advice and actions
extraChecks: Changes to real hover, focus, or cursor geometry require the existing editorUX and packaged-native checks.

title: Persist and reverse review decisions
extraChecks: Persistence changes require the real rooted Go writing-decision adapter tests; focus changes need the existing native/browser boundary.

title: File tree, mutations, and vault safety
extraChecks: Run go test ./internal/desktop for backend changes, retaining real os.Root containment, collision, rollback, and CSS rename coverage. For Windows rename hangs, capture the packaged app's last progress stage and storage location; Linux checks do not establish native Windows completion. Include slow_history_test.go for save/path-lock ordering.

title: Tab ownership, saving, and session continuity
extraChecks: Add the affected session/undo tests; focus or tab geometry changes need the existing tab/browser boundary.

title: Editor Find and accessible match status
extraChecks: Reuse the existing editorUX Find workflow for native focus and panel layout.

title: Global note search
extraChecks: Run go test ./internal/search for backend search rules; keyboard focus changes need the existing accessibility browser scenario.

title: Backlinks and unlinked mentions
extraChecks: Relationship backend changes require go test ./internal/desktop; actual popup/windowing focus needs the existing browser boundary.

title: Vault graph layout and interaction
extraChecks: Run go test ./internal/desktop for backend graph changes; canvas geometry and pointer interaction need the existing graph browser boundary.

title: Document outline and sticky headings
extraChecks: Run the existing outline browser scenario and packaged native check for heading geometry, scroll alignment, or focus changes.

title: Kanban, calendar, and task dates
extraChecks: Run go test ./internal/taskschedule for task policy; use existing Kanban/calendar browser scenarios only for geometry and native events.

title: History restoration and file revisions
extraChecks: Run go test -race ./internal/history ./internal/desktop for Git/filesystem changes, including commit_plan_test.go, commit_file_test.go, and desktop/slow_history_test.go; use actual temporary repositories.

title: PDF preview, rendering, and export
extraChecks: Run go test ./internal/pdfexport for export adapters; preserve consolidated preview/export browser coverage when rendering or frame wiring changes.

title: Exact Markdown source preview
extraChecks: Actual scroll alignment, clipboard delivery, and focus changes require the existing raw preview browser/native boundary.

title: Mermaid and diagram scheduling
extraChecks: Use charts for Vega/Vega-Lite editing. Add affected Draw.io/table tests for those formats; frame, geometry, or printable changes need existing browser boundaries.

title: Vega and Vega-Lite chart editing
extraChecks: Changes to graphic measurements or printable output need the existing chart and preview/export browser boundaries; use diagrams for shared scheduling.
Run tests/e2e/vegaLiteChartEditor.spec.js for chart SVG replacement, connected-container sizing, controls, resize and source-selection geometry.

title: Approved UI primitives and themes
extraChecks: Run npm run lint and npm run build:design-system; new families/primitives/variants require explicit user approval before implementation.

title: Eager loading, bundling, and hydration
extraChecks: Run npm run build:app; use the existing productionBundle browser contract for assembled startup changes.

title: Preferences and machine-local settings
extraChecks: Run go test ./internal/settings ./internal/desktop for persistence, migrations, and native settings boundaries.

title: Release metadata, packaging, and Git handoff
extraChecks: For release preparation read the complete release skill; focused checks neither finalize nor replace its verification and version/action approval.
Run bash tests/release/prepare-release.test.sh, including native editorial-profile failure before finalization.

title: Feature index, agent routing, and verification
extraChecks: Run npm run context:check; audit moved documentation links and preserve all required broader checks.
